purpose: Compare a fixed CNN trained from random initialization against the frozen pretrained MobileNetV3-Small under the same D1-D4 dataset definitions and protected-test information boundary.

shared_rules.data_augmentation: RandomResizedCrop(160, scale=0.90-1.00, ratio=0.95-1.05), RandomHorizontalFlip(0.5), ColorJitter(brightness=0.10, contrast=0.10), ImageNet normalization
shared_rules.final_refit: After each family locks its own epoch using D2 development only, retrain D1-D4 from that family's frozen initialization rule on each dataset's full non-test training portion.
shared_rules.final_evaluation: Evaluate all 8 frozen models (2 families x D1-D4) in one locked invocation.

pretrained_mobilenetv3_small.architecture: torchvision MobileNetV3-Small with final classifier replaced by Linear(in_features,1)

optimizer_schedule.epochs_3_plus: last four feature blocks + classifier; AdamW lr=0.0002 weight_decay=0.0001

required_comparisons: scratch vs pretrained within each of D1,D2,D3,D4
D1 vs D2 within each model family
D3 vs D4 within each model family
all-image vs deduplicated contrasts with interpretation guardrails
reporting.guardrail: Dataset test populations differ by design. Report metric differences descriptively; do not present them as causal estimates.
